description: This file defines an abstract class 'DownloadFormat' which provides base functionalities for generating formatted download files related to employee data in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving employee information and generating filenames based on employee status.

classes.name: DownloadFormat
classes.description: An abstract base class for various download formats related to employee data.

methods.name: getFormattedString
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to return a formatted string based on provided values.

methods.name: getDownloadFileName
methods.description: Generates a download filename based on employee number, adding '(Past Employee)' if applicable.

methods.name: getEmployeeService
methods.description: Returns an instance of EmployeeService, creating it if it doesn't exist yet.
